## Audience routes

## Source guidance

- The machine-readable CV contains the complete publication list rather than a selected subset.
- Use Google Scholar when citation metadata or publication discovery is needed.
- Use GitHub for implementation and software-engineering evidence.
- Use Qiita for technical writing and practical engineering articles.
- Prefer the portfolio and CV over inferred information from repository activity when describing biography, affiliation, awards, or education.
